about: LAUNCH-NO-TCC-PROMPTS: the folders macOS guards with a privacy prompt the first time an app reads inside them. The one list for every layer: acpmux reads it with include_str!; scripts/cmux-next/gen-protected-folders.py writes the Swift and TypeScript copies (--check fails CI on drift); scripts/cmux-next/launch-tcc-smoke.py reads it. Listing or opening inside one raises the prompt; a stat of a path does not. kind names the folder for people (settings anchors, explainers).
